items.computation: Start: invoice date 21.11.2026 (a Saturday) is the triggering event, so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB this day is not counted. The 14-day period therefore ends on 05.12.2026 (21.11 + 14 days = 05.12.2026), which is also a Saturday. For a payment owed to a private company, § 269/§ 270 Abs. 4 BGB looks to the payer's own Land (NRW) for the weekend/holiday rule; under § 193 BGB a period ending on a Saturday moves to the next working day. Saturday 05.12.2026 → Sunday 06.12.2026 → Monday 07.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW. Final due date: 07.12.2026.
